integrity: Proof reconstructed from definitions; bundled finite checker supports, but does not replace, the general proof. Literature searches did not establish publication-level novelty beyond the inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Finite models; the chromatic construction requires at least two agents. The achieved size m*chi(G) is not claimed globally minimal for every model. Worst-case optimality is proved only for two-agent S5 targets among covers retaining equivalence relations.
title: Chromatic compression of proper relational covers
